questions.title: Where will you ride?
questions.prompt: Choose the surface that best represents most of your riding.

options.label: Mostly paved
options.description: Roads, cycle paths and smooth urban surfaces.

options.label: Mixed surfaces
options.description: Pavement plus gravel, rough paths or light off-road.

options.label: Trail
options.description: Roots, rocks, loose surfaces and sustained off-road riding.

options.label: Technical trail
options.description: Steep, rough or obstacle-heavy terrain where control dominates.

questions.title: What matters most?
questions.prompt: Pick the quality you would notice most if the bike got it wrong.

options.label: Speed & efficiency
options.description: Cover distance quickly with low energy loss.

options.label: Balanced versatility
options.description: A mix of efficiency, comfort and changing surfaces.

options.label: Control & capability
options.description: Confidence and traction matter more than outright speed.

questions.title: How long are typical rides?
questions.prompt: Use your normal ride, not the rare longest day.

options.label: Under 15 km
options.description: Short rides where long-distance efficiency is secondary.

options.label: 15–50 km
options.description: Efficiency matters, but not at all costs.

options.label: 50+ km
options.description: Sustained efficiency becomes a major requirement.

questions.title: How much climbing?
questions.prompt: Think about how often long or steep climbs shape the ride.

options.label: Little
options.description: Mostly flat or gentle terrain.

options.label: Regular
options.description: Rolling terrain with meaningful climbs.

options.label: A lot / steep
options.description: Climbing performance matters on many rides.

questions.title: How much do you need to carry?
questions.prompt: This helps Bike Atlas detect when the current catalog lacks the right utility bike.

options.label: Almost none
options.description: Bottle, phone and small essentials.

options.label: Light luggage
options.description: Small backpack or occasional compact bag.

options.label: Regular cargo
options.description: Groceries, work loads, child/cargo duties or substantial panniers.

questions.title: How much complexity will you tolerate?
questions.prompt: More capability can bring more service points and setup.

options.label: Keep it simple
options.description: Low maintenance burden is important.

options.label: Normal upkeep
options.description: Routine bicycle maintenance is fine.

options.label: Complexity is fine
options.description: Extra setup and service are acceptable for capability.

questions.title: What conditions?
questions.prompt: How much must the bike tolerate imperfect weather and surfaces?

options.label: Mostly fair
options.description: Bad weather is occasional.

options.label: Mixed conditions
options.description: Rain, dirt and changing conditions are normal.

options.label: All-weather priority
options.description: Reliable use in poor conditions matters strongly.
